Report title: Survey of Sexual Victimization in Adult Correctional Facilities, 2012-2018 – Statistical Tables  NCJ 252836
Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Survey of Sexual Victimization, 2012-2018
Authors: Laura M. Maruschak and Emily D. Buehler, Ph.D., BJS Statisticians
Table 1. Allegations and substantiated incidents of sexual victimization, by type of adult correctional facility, 2012-2018

Note: Includes inmate-on-inmate nonconsensual sexual acts, inmate-on-inmate abusive sexual contact, staff-on-inmate sexual misconduct, and staff-on-inmate sexual harassment. Excludes inmate-on-inmate sexual harassment. Data may have been revised from previously published statistics. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. See appendix table 1 for standard errors.
^Too few cases to provide a reliable estimate.
a/Includes state-operated facilities that are intended for adults but sometimes hold juveniles and facilities that are operated by the Federal Bureau of Prisons.
c/Includes military prisons, dedicated U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement facilities, and Indian country jails. Excludes Indian country jails that house only juveniles.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Survey of Sexual Victimization, 2012-2018.
